# Costa Rica SEO

> Costa Rica SEO (costarica-seo.com) helps Costa Rican businesses get found on Google and in AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), with local SEO, AI search optimization (AIO) and marketing aimed at tourists and locals. English site; the Spanish-language site is agenciaseoencostarica.com.

## Pages
- [Home](https://costarica-seo.com/): services, how it works, FAQ and a free consultation form

## Related sites in Costa Rica
- [Agencia SEO en Costa Rica](https://agenciaseoencostarica.com/): Spanish-language site

## Key facts
- Run by Eye To Ad Media, a digital marketing agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, in business since 2012
- No ranking guarantees; clients own their domain, website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638 (toll-free), WhatsApp +1 720-249-6588, info@eyetoad.com, or the form at https://costarica-seo.com/
